title: Why Does Voice AI Still Struggle With Kenyans’ Speech?
summary: When people read prepared text aloud, AI can transcribe Swahili with remarkably few errors, and Swahili speech recognition looks close to solved. A March 2026 preprint by a team including a Harvard University researcher reports a 3.24 percent word error rate on recordings from Mo
